name: tristan-shadowdancer-redirect-does-not-rest-champion
notes: Tristan, Shadowdancer (he6kd7hocc): "Remove two preparation counters from Tristan: Change the target of an attack that targets Tristan to a phantasia ally you control." The printed cost has NO [REST]. FIXED (was: Redirect also rested Tristan; this fixture used to be named tristan-shadowdancer-redirect-attack-to-phantasia and its REGRESSION GUARD assertion pinned Status 1 after the redirect). Root cause: DoActivatedAbility() (Custom/GameLogic.php) sets Status = 1 as the implicit [REST] cost for every static ability of an ALLY/CHAMPION/PHANTASIA unless the card id is in the hard-coded $skipAutoRest list; he6kd7hocc was missing (trace: cardID=he6kd7hocc idx=0 static=1 skip=0 before=2). Fix: he6kd7hocc added to $skipAutoRest. Setup: player 1's champion is patched to Shadowdancer with exactly 2 preparation counters and an Ominous Shadow is seeded; player 2 declares a real attack with a Dungeon Guide (1 POWER) on Tristan, player 1 is offered "myField-0@Activate-0@Redirect" in the opportunity window, the handler (customDQHandlers["he6kd7hocc:0:ActivateAbility-1"]) removes the counters and MarkCombatTarget()s the Shadow. Asserted: Tristan awake (Status 2) after the activation, counters spent, attack redirected, Tristan undamaged. Per-step dump confirms Tristan is Status 2 at every step.

rulesClauses: Remove two preparation counters from Tristan: Change the target of an attack that targets Tristan to a phantasia ally you control. (no [REST] in the cost: Tristan stays awake)

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Fix: add he6kd7hocc (and the other proven non-[REST] unit abilities 0ejcyuvuxn, xW6SZSlJX6, peyG8Hfgqt) to $skipAutoRest.
